result.note: percentile per metric among the qubits that have it (0 = most stable); composite = their mean; a VETO (broken or unmeasured vendor readout/T1, an in-circuit readout or Ramsey change between jobs at chi2/dof > 25, a flagged telegraph switch) sorts a qubit after every clean one. Vendor metrics cover every qubit; in-circuit ones only the qubits these five jobs measured, so a qubit no job saw cannot be vetoed by them
